name: SambaNova Cloud
tagline: High-throughput LLM inference on SambaNova RDU hardware
description: SambaCloud is an RDU-powered, high-throughput inference platform for supported open-source models. Developers create self-service API keys and use OpenAI-compatible APIs, including Chat Completions and Responses. Hosted models are designated for production or preview workloads.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header (OpenAI-compatible). Keys created in SambaNova Cloud console after signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: New accounts receive $5 in API credits without a credit card; credits expire after 30 days. Eligible Free Tier models allow 20 RPM, 20 RPD, and 200,000 tokens/day per model.
pricing.paid_plans: Usage-based and enterprise plans; see cloud.sambanova.ai pricing for current rates

rate_limits: Published by model and tier. Eligible Free Tier models: 20 RPM, 20 RPD, and 200,000 TPD per model. Developer limits vary by model and include a 20-million-token daily limit across all models.
use_cases: run chat completions with OpenAI-compatible API against SambaNova models
stream high-throughput LLM responses for production apps
switch model IDs for Llama and other hosted open models
benchmark or offload inference to RDU-backed endpoints
